content.comment_body: Hello experts, I need to generate a current loop output signal from my [product_name]. However, the manual states that the [product_name] expansion module only supports 0-10V output. I recall there is a 0-20mA variant available. Can anyone provide a model reference for the current loop version so I can verify its specifications? I haven't located it on the [company_name] website, but I might have overlooked it. Thank you in advance for your help.
Hello, Is your manual the latest version?

[user_name], thanks for replying. I downloaded the manual from my supplier's website this morning. The document is from 02/2005, reference [document]. It matches my paper copy. Is there a more recent version, and if so, where can I locate it? I tried the [company_name] website, but searching for documents seems quite convoluted.

Is the updated [product_name] module with current loop output identified by part reference: [article_no]? And is the previous module lacking current loop: [article_no]? My supplier claims to only stock the older version, should I look for a different supplier or is this just an error? I think I found the updated manual on the [company_name] website at: [url]

Hello, During an industry event, a [company_name] representative explained that it's straightforward to access information about [company_name] products: simply visit www.[company_name].com/ and add the product name you need information on. For your case: www.[company_name].com/[product_name] I've tried it and it works well, also for other control systems. This tip has saved me a lot of time and effort. Hope it is helpful.

The page you've found is the correct one for documentation. Your supplier should update their site, considering it’s years out of date. [article_no] refers to the older module with 0...10V output. [article_no] is the newer module, offering outputs of 0...10V, 0...20mA, and 4...20mA. Suppliers should be able to obtain the newer module; others do this, so maybe your supplier wants to clear old inventory first. Please review documentation about how the analog output of the expansion module responds to internal values.
[user_name], thanks for the helpful advice. I've located another supplier who can provide the module for testing. I'll update the thread once I've tried it.

analysis.insight_summary: This discussion highlights confusion around the features and model references for the [product_name] analog output expansion modules, especially for current loop (0-20mA, 4-20mA) capability. Users struggle to find updated manuals and correct product details due to outdated documentation and supplier information, while navigating the [company_name] website is found to be inefficient for confirming product specs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek clear and accessible documentation, accurate identification of module features, and reliable information on which versions support current loop outputs.
